Practice chanters in 3D

How to use this view

Drag to turn; right-drag, shift-drag or move two fingers to slide the view; scroll or pinch to zoom in on whatever is under the pointer; double-click a part to turn round it, and Reset view to go back. Draw Explode to spread the plates along the chanter. Every plate is the cut files’ own outline. The finger-hole plates are darker: a slot through the face, or a V where a hole too small to cut is drilled. The cap, paler, is on, its socket over the body’s top plates. The buttons switch between two strip chanters, bores of finger-jointed strips, darker, under stacked plates: standard, square, with a measured chanter’s holes; and standard octagon, eight strips with those holes as slots; then the plate bores, three sides to eight.
